run.where: machine or Modal run, cpu, image, embedding model
run.command: the exact command that produced the raw scores

commit.measured_sha: 40-hex SHA the binary was built from
commit.dirty_note: say so if the tree was dirty and why
commit.release_tag_commit: SHA of the tag, when it differs from the measured SHA
commit.release_tag_difference: what differs between the two, or 'none'

dependencies.cargo_lock_sha256_at_measured_sha: sha256 of Cargo.lock at the measured SHA
dependencies.other: anything else that changes the numbers, or 'pinned by the lock file'

dataset.sha256: sha256 of the file that was used
dataset.revision: pinned revision, or say it was not pinned

raw_scores.file: relative path to the committed per-question NDJSON

recompute: the command that regenerates summary.json from the raw scores
